source: adapter-authored compact prompts for docs/plans/eval-corpus.json E2E scenarios

prompts.E2E-01: Fix the bug in src/sample.ts where add(1,2) returns 4. Make the smallest fix, run the test, report done.
prompts.E2E-02: Add a new exported function formatDate(iso) to src/util.ts returning YYYY-MM-DD, with a test. Use task() for the implementation if helpful.
prompts.E2E-03: Start ultra-work: plan the TODO list for adding an LRU cache to this repo, then start working on it.
prompts.E2E-04: Plan a small feature: add a ping endpoint to the server. Run the planning flow, then hand off via /start-work.
prompts.E2E-05: There are two tasks in the plan: T1 setup, T2 feature (depends on T1). Start executing the plan.
prompts.E2E-06: What does the file src/README.md contain? Please answer briefly.
prompts.E2E-07: Run the test suite twice, then report the failures and how you fixed them.
prompts.E2E-08: Delegate a tiny research task to a subagent and report what it returned.
prompts.E2E-09: Produce a long analysis of this repository, longer than 2000 words.
prompts.E2E-10: Record the current role, switch it if needed, and report the role and revision.
prompts.E2E-11: Make a request that requires a missing credential and report what is blocking you.
prompts.E2E-12: We depend on an external service that is down. Report how you would proceed.
prompts.E2E-13: Mark all plan TODOs complete except the Final Verification Wave, then report status.
prompts.E2E-14: Two readers should read src/util.ts while one writer edits it. Simulate with tools and report conflicts.
prompts.E2E-15: Create a team of two members, send one a message, then shut the team down.
prompts.E2E-16: Start a hyperplan adversarial planning session for a trivial feature.
prompts.E2E-17: List the tools you have available that start with omo_.
